sourceName: Caltrans Safety Roadside Rest Areas (GIS Open Data)
method: Downloaded the dataset's GeoJSON export (hub.arcgis.com/api/download/v1/items/82e6f835427a4035a354ba1df47f603b/geojson) and filtered to ROUTE values 101, 5, 395, 80 that fall on the trip's CA corridors. This is Caltrans' own facility inventory (official coordinates, route, postmile, amenities) -- not a user-report aggregator.
policyNote: California rest area overnight limit is 8 hours in any 24-hour period, sleeping in the vehicle permitted, camping prohibited -- Cal. Code Regs. tit. 21, section 2205(b), confirmed by direct fetch of the regulation text at law.cornell.edu/regulations/california/21-CCR-2205 on 2026-08-12.

records.name: Gaviota Safety Roadside Rest Area (northbound)
records.notes: US-101 northbound, at the south end of the Gaviota Tunnel, Santa Barbara County. Closest official CA rest area to Ventura on the 101 corridor (~33 mi north). Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump station. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a). Lot grade, lighting and typical noise level are not stated by Caltrans -- expect Highway 101 tunnel traffic noise; unverified beyond that.
records.statusNote: Closed per the Caltrans live SRRA status feed, re-checked 2026-08-13 (feed timestamped 08/13/2026 6:11am): "Closed due to Intermittent Closures, Expected to re-open 10/01/2026 08:01 AM" (SRRA 90500017). Re-add as a live pin once the feed reports it Open -- do not restore on the expected date alone.

records.name: Gaviota Safety Roadside Rest Area (southbound)
records.notes: US-101 southbound counterpart to the northbound Gaviota rest area, same tunnel location, Santa Barbara County. records.statusNote: Closed per the Caltrans live SRRA status feed, re-checked 2026-08-13 (feed timestamped 08/13/2026 6:11am): "Closed due to Intermittent Closures, Expected to re-open 10/01/2026 08:01 AM" (SRRA 90500018). records.name: Tejon Pass Safety Roadside Rest Area (northbound)
records.notes: I-5 northbound at the Tejon Pass/Grapevine summit, Kern County, 3.5 mi north of Gorman -- the I-5 waypoint on the way from the Ventura/LA basin area toward SR-14/US-395. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump. Summit elevation ~4200 ft -- can be cold, windy, occasionally icy in winter (not covered by the Caltrans facility record; noted from general route knowledge, not a verified source claim). 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a).
records.statusNote: Closed per the Caltrans live SRRA status feed, re-checked 2026-08-13 (feed timestamped 08/13/2026 6:11am): "Closed due to Rest Area Maintenance, No estimate for when facility will re-open." (SRRA 90600067). Indefinite -- there is no date to re-check against, so re-run scripts/check-rest-area-status.mjs before any trip that would depend on it.

records.name: Tejon Pass Safety Roadside Rest Area (southbound)
records.notes: I-5 southbound counterpart at Tejon Pass, Kern County. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a).
records.statusNote: Suppressed as a precaution -- the live SRRA feed carries NO status for this facility, re-checked 2026-08-13. Correction to the 2026-08-12 note: the feed's two Tejon Pass entries are not a mislabelling, they are an exact duplicate of the NORTHBOUND record (both SRRA 90600067, identical coordinates -118.87/34.8257). Southbound (SRRA 90600068 by the district's numbering, sitting between Tejon NB 90600067 and Philip S. Raine NB 90600069) is simply absent from all 84 feed placemarks, so its state is unknown, not confirmed open. Given the northbound side of the same summit complex is closed for indefinite maintenance, this stays suppressed until the feed publishes a southbound record.

records.name: Coso Junction Safety Roadside Rest Area
records.notes: US-395, Olancha area, Inyo County, 17 mi south of the Rte 395/190 junction -- squarely on the Mojave-to-Bishop leg of the trip. Serves both directions (Caltrans lists N & S). Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a). Open high desert -- expect wind and highway noise; lighting not stated by source.
records.statusNote: Closed per the Caltrans live SRRA status feed, re-checked 2026-08-13 (feed timestamped 08/13/2026 6:11am): "Closed due to Emergency Work, No estimate for when facility will re-open." (SRRA 90900017, serves both directions). Indefinite -- no date to re-check against; re-run scripts/check-rest-area-status.mjs before relying on US-395 coverage here.

records.name: Division Creek Safety Roadside Rest Area
records.notes: US-395, Inyo County, 10 mi north of Independence -- between Bishop and Lee Vining. Serves both directions. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a).

records.name: Crestview Safety Roadside Rest Area
records.notes: US-395, Mono County, 6.4 mi north of the June Lake Junction (SR-203) -- the closest official CA rest area to Lee Vining on the 395 corridor. Serves both directions. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a). High desert, ~7000 ft -- can be cold at night even in summer; not confirmed by source, general route knowledge.

records.name: Donner Summit Safety Roadside Rest Area (eastbound)
records.notes: I-80 eastbound on Donner Pass, Nevada County -- high-Sierra stop on the I-80 leg into Reno. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a). Summit elevation ~7200 ft: snow/ice possible outside summer, chain control zone -- not part of the Caltrans facility record, noted from general route knowledge.

records.notes: I-80 westbound counterpart at Gold Run/Dutch Flat, Placer County. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour parking limit per 21 CCR 2205(b); sleeping in the vehicle within that limit is permitted, camping is prohibited per 21 CCR 2205(a).
records.statusNote: REOPENED. Suppressed on 2026-08-12 after the live SRRA feed showed it Closed; the 2026-08-13 re-check shows SRRA 90300066 Open with full amenities, so it is a live pin again. statusCheck.source: Caltrans QuickMap live SRRA status feed
statusCheck.note: The static Caltrans GIS export carries no open/closed field; this live feed does. Re-check with scripts/check-rest-area-status.mjs. KNOWN GAP: that script only compares SHIPPED pins (public/data/*.geojson) against the feed, so it catches open-pin-actually-closed but is blind to closed-record-actually-reopened -- Gold Run westbound sat wrongly suppressed for a day because of it. Until the checker reads this source file directly, diff the closed records here against the feed by hand.
